name: Hybrid Shading
aliases: Mixture of gradient-based shading with volumetric shading
definition: A hybrid method blending gradient-based shading (local details) and volumetric shading (global ambient occlusion) to balance local/global features and noise.
summary: Hybrid Shading blends gradient-based and volumetric shading via dynamic interpolation to balance local details and global occlusion, offering a softer appearance effective for noisy data.
